name: vapi
label: Vapi
description: AI voice agent platform. Create outbound calls, manage assistants, and retrieve call details.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To obtain your Vapi API key:

  1. Log in to your [Vapi Dashboard](https://dashboard.vapi.ai).
  2. Navigate to **Organization Settings** → **API Keys**.
  3. Copy your Private API key.

create_call.label: Create Call
create_call.description: Create an outbound phone call using a Vapi assistant.

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.description: The ID of the Vapi assistant that will handle the call. Get this from your Vapi Dashboard.

phoneNumberId.label: Phone Number ID
phoneNumberId.description: The ID of the phone number to make the call from. Must be a number registered in your Vapi account.

customerNumber.label: Customer Phone Number
customerNumber.description: The phone number to call, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234).

name.label: Call Name
name.description: An optional name for this call for identification.

assistantOverrides.label: Assistant Overrides
assistantOverrides.description: Optional JSON object with assistant configuration overrides for this call (e.g. first message, model settings).

get_call.label: Get Call
get_call.description: Retrieve the details of a specific call by its ID.

callId.label: Call ID
callId.description: The unique identifier of the call to retrieve.

update_assistant.label: Update Assistant
update_assistant.description: Update an existing Vapi assistant configuration (name, model, first message, etc.).

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.description: The unique identifier of the assistant to update.

name.label: Name
name.description: A new name for the assistant.

firstMessage.label: First Message
firstMessage.description: The first message the assistant will say when a call starts.

instructions.label: System Prompt / Instructions
instructions.description: Optional system prompt. Vapi does not expose a standalone top-level instructions field on UpdateAssistantDto, so if you provide this you must also provide both Model and Provider so the system prompt can be applied via model.messages without discarding your input silently.

model.label: Model
model.description: Optional model name (e.g. gpt-4o). Required if updating model config.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Optional model provider (e.g. openai). Required if updating model config.

endCallMessage.label: End Call Message
endCallMessage.description: The message the assistant says before ending the call.

overrides.label: Additional Overrides
overrides.description: Optional JSON object with additional UpdateAssistantDTO fields (e.g. model, voice, transcriber settings).
